steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil over high heat. Stir in fusilli and return to a boil. Cook, uncovered and stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Lightly grease a casserole dish.
Melt margarine in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in milk until entirely incorporated.

Add cheese food, blue cheese, Cheddar, salt, pepper, and mustard; cook and stir continually until cheeses have melted and mixture is thick. Fold in pasta until coated, then pour mixture into the prepared casserole dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until the top begins to brown, about 20 minutes.

review.reviewBody: Contrary to the other reviewer's statements, this recipe calls for 8 oz or 1/2 a package of pasta, which I found to be just the right amount to support the amazing, cheesy, rich sauce. I omitted the onion to suit personal taste, but followed the recipe for everything else. This is grown up Mac and cheese! Thanks for sharing, Tiger.

This is delicious! I added garlic in with the onion at the roux stage. I was making a double recipe, and it does make a LOT of sauce. Even though I only made 1 and 1/2 recipe of the sauce, it was more than enough for double the noodles! I didn’t bake, just threw it in the crock pot on warm for a pot luck.

FABULOUS! My boyfriend said it might be too good!I made some changes to try and make it a bit healthier and it went unnoticed! I substituted an entire box (14.5 oz) of Ronzoni Smart Taste Rotini (purple box) to reduce the calories, used skim milk and AP whole wheat flour. Used the whole stick of margarine but could probably get away with 1/2. Also used Gorgonzola and Sharp Cheddar for more flavor and topped the mac & cheese with some Parmesan/Romano blend and plain bread crumbs then sprayed it with Pam so it would brown up. So flavorful and rich!

I would personally add a little more blue cheese and a little more ground mustard. I put two cloves of minced garlic with it which was great, but I think I’m going to put three next time and a little more onion. I would recommend only baking it may be 10 minutes at most to keep it moist. Crispy crumbled bacon on top would probably work well with too.

Crazy good mac and cheese. I use butter instead of margarine and usually use elbow pasta. Rather than cook it in the oven, I boil to pasta to desired doneness and fold the sauce in letting it set in the hot pot w/ the heat turned off until I serve. The dish is very saucy and has an excellent flavor!

This mac & cheese is a winner! The combination of sharp cheddar and blue cheese was a delightfully unexpected treat. I've been craving mac & cheese for weeks, but got frustrated trying to figure out how to make it gluten free. I substituted the regular pasta for a GF option, and used all-purpose GF flour. Since the pasta doesn't have the gluten to bind it together, the pasta fell apart when I mixed in the cheese sauce, but the flavor was still delicious. I also doubled the recipe to make sure I had leftovers to snack on the next day.

Velveeta makes a white version of their classic cube in little squeeze packets so I used this as the "processes cheese food." I also used a white Vermont cheddar. I doubled recipe as-is (only edit was adding a dash of nutmeg) for a party and it was fantastic. Was hard to stop from eating it all before my guests came!

Delicious! I put in a bit more velveeta and cheddar cheese than called for and I wish i had put in a bit more blue cheese than called for, as i could taste it much. I do recommend baking it, as that lets the flavors meld and the noodles soak up the sauce- the sauce looked like too much before I baked it, but after it was perfect. 

Next time I will add some veggies and/or meat!

Needed more noodles. Too cheesy! I don’t care for the flavor that much maybe I’ll switch the blue cheese for Swiss. Would be better with some pretzel crumbles on top. However my daughter loved it, said it was the best Mac and cheese she has ever had! She agreed it needed a topping too.

This was a really nice mac and cheese recipe. I used more onion than called for (like 1/4 cup total), slightly more velveeta (for a more cheesier flavor) and after tasting it and deciding it needed a little something more, about 1/2 teaspoon granulated garlic. Next time I will use fresh garlic (1-2 cloves), and cook it with the onions. When I first tasted the sauce on it's own I wasn't impressed, but once I added the noodles and baked it, the flavors melded perfectly. Don't be fooled by the amount of blue cheese used, you can definately taste it, but in a good way. I will use this recipe again from time to time for something different from the norm! Thanks for posting. :)

I debated over reviewing this recipe because I changed it due to a lack of ingredients, but I love that this recipe was simple and delicious! I used macaroni noodles instead of spirals and I do not have blue cheese or Velveeta. I followed (doubled) the recipe and instructions using sharp cheddar and fresh parmesan as my cheeses, because that's what I had on hand. I also omitted the dry mustard because I didn't have that either. The onion made this recipe in my opinion. It turned out absolutely delicious and sinful!

My Family and I wanted to try something new and found this recipe. We did change somethings like we used elbow noodles and only used colby-jack cheese to cover for all other cheeses. We all loved it and will definitely make it again!

This is a good recipe it tastes AMAZING! I will say that it uses a lot of sauce. I also added my secret ingredient. Garlic salt. It tastes really good so if anyone wants to try that i would recommend it. Also the recipe is really complicated and hard to understand. Or maybe that’s me. Overall it’s a good recipe and a way to cool down on a Sunday evening
I love mac
Turned out great and easy to make. I used what I had on hand; cheddar, Jack, feta and Parmesan. The Grands loved it.
My family loved it!
This was delish! Did everything exactly as written, only I added a small chopped onion and about a tsp of minced garlic. YUM!
Grownup Baked Mac & Cheese!
This is such a fantastic Mac n cheese recipe! I’ve made it several times. I sometimes swap out the blue cheese for pepper jack and it still works well. My go to recipe for Mac n cheese forever!
I used almond milk instead of regular. I also added ground beef & broccoli. I will surely make this recipe again! Thanks
